method: Selected internationally reported or officially announced changes; separate facts from potential Kazakhstan effects

records.title: EU adopts extensive new sanctions listings targeting Russia's military-industrial supply chains

other_sources.label: Associated Press report
other_sources.role: Independent news reporting; final legal text and implementation require verification

records.summary: News reports describe the EU adopting nearly 1,600 additional sanctions listings connected with Russia's military-industrial supply chains. Exact legal obligations and affected persons/entities require checking the EU's operative instruments.
records.reason: Potential sanctions-compliance, finance, payment, trade diversion and Russian input-supply exposure for Kazakhstan companies; Kazakhstan-specific effects have not been demonstrated.
records.status: Multi-outlet reporting; EU legal instruments not inspected

exposure_channels.name: Sanctions compliance and payments
exposure_channels.mechanism: Kazakhstan financial institutions and firms with counterparties named in measures may face new compliance or transaction constraints.

exposure_channels.name: Trade and supply inputs
exposure_channels.mechanism: Russian intermediate goods and logistics links could face additional scrutiny if covered by the measures.

records.title: European Commission selects 46 strategic critical raw material projects

other_sources.label: EU selected project register
other_sources.role: European Commission selected strategic projects register

records.summary: The European Commission selected 46 projects in 16 EU member states for Strategic Project status under the Critical Raw Materials Act. Selection can ease permitting and financing access but does not establish that projects are operational or fully financed.
records.reason: Future EU mining and processing capacity may alter buyers, investment incentives and competitive conditions for Kazakhstan's mineral exports and downstream industrial plans.
records.status: Official European Commission announcement; Kazakhstan market effects hypothetical

exposure_channels.name: Critical minerals competition
exposure_channels.mechanism: Additional EU processing capacity may change mineral demand and offtake patterns relative to Kazakhstan's production.

exposure_channels.name: Investment and processing incentives
exposure_channels.mechanism: EU policy support could alter where downstream mineral refining investment is located.

records.title: EU and China announce preliminary arrangement on hybrid vehicle trade
records.summary: EU and China reported a preliminary trade arrangement following consultations on market access and hybrid vehicle exports. Its final approval, legal force and details are not established by the preliminary announcement.
records.reason: Possible indirect trade diversion, automotive manufacturing competition, intermediate-input demand, and China–EU supply-chain shifts relevant to Kazakhstan; magnitude unknown.
records.status: Preliminary announcement reported; not yet implemented binding rules

exposure_channels.name: Automotive trade diversion
exposure_channels.mechanism: Changed China–EU access, if implemented, could redirect vehicle exports or related investment through other markets including Central Asia.
